positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: I work on the Azure IoT Operations (AIO) team. As part of the AIO team, I architected the initial data platform for ingesting data from IoT devices, normalizing the data based on a customer's data format, and contextualizing the data to allow for the data to be exported to various Azure data stores. In addition, I have driven an org wide effort to understand the complexities of onboarding AIO to various Kubernetes platforms, such as Tanzu and OpenShift, and I have orchestrated efforts across the various teams to ship support for these platforms.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I work on the Azure IoT Central team. As part of the Azure IoT Central team, I work on IoT Central data plane, a hyper scale real-time stream processing pipeline, that processes incoming telemetry from IoT devices and filters and transforms and enriches them for consumption for downstream services.
I am currently working on building a new streaming pipeline that will help reduce latencies for our customers as well as adding new data transformation capabilities to allow our customers to send more complex data types to IoT Central.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I work on the Azure IoT Location Based Services Mapping team. We provide mapping functionality to enterprise customers while keeping their data secure. We provide and develop a full service stack of spatial and mapping functionality within Azure. 
I am currently developing the indoor maps scenarios in Azure which includes providing a suite of services that allow our customers to upload drawings or DWGs of their facilities, convert their drawings into map data, store the data, and allow it to be consumed in the creation of map tiles for the Azure Maps map control.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
The Postmates business is a complex and fast-paced three sided marketplace, where customers, Postmates couriers, and merchants interact in real-team to deliver a highly useful service that supports local commerce and local jobs. 

I work on building services, tools, frameworks, and infrastructure for the Fleet/Fulfillment Team to enable couriers and merchants to work more efficiently and effectively, including development, testing, and operations. 

I integrated a new preparation time estimator into our partner merchant experience and our core application to allow for better estimation to our couriers from our merchants and provide better overall delivery times to our customers. I have integrated this throughout the customer experience, from search, to order, and finally to delivery, to provide a more accurate and fully synchronized experience for our customers. 

I rearchitected the the core web service that allows access to all our machine learning models which increased load capacity and decreased latency allowing for better utilization of our services and saving the company thousands of dollars per month on resources. 

I saved the company tens of thousands of dollars by creating the infrastructure and tools to enable the Growth team to forecast the demand for our product and predict which promotions and specials work best as well as enable our customer support team to more accurately predict staffing needs based on the predicted demand. 

I built out the logging framework to enable our Search and Recommendations team to aggregate logs into a common persistent storage to enable improvement to be made to their search algorithms.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
I worked on the Bing Maps Routing team, which handles routing directions for all map requests around the world including development, testing, and operations of the the Bing Maps services.
  - Directional APIs running different algorithms to determine the best route for multiple different modes: Auto/Walking/Transit.
  - Machine learning and data analysis of various forms of data, including traffic and transit data.
  - APIs that enable clients to integrate mapping features into their products, including Cortana, Bing Maps website, Mobile Maps Apps.
I was the lead developer for the Directions team on a large scale cross-platform mapping project integrated into both Desktop and mobile platforms.
